Controls

Left drag places blocks, right drag erases. Scroll zooms, middle drag or Space + drag pans (two fingers on touch). Keys 1–0 pick blocks. The nose points right.

Cannons, lasers and point defence can only fire where the shot won't pass through your own ship: hover a gun (or turn on Arcs) to see where. Guns that stick out cover more. Missile launchers and heavy lasers fire in any direction.
